title: Is anyone interested in a FF4/FF6 style engine as a resource ?

posts.author: ZombieBear
posts.body:
Hello, haven't been on here for like, 10 years! Anyway, after digging around a bit it seems this is the right place to post.
So, I have no head for narrative, so I just CAN'T design a game story to save my life.
But what I DID create was a complete FF4/FF6 style game engine. As in the entire functioning base for a game. I even created a town interior/exterior tileset, a cave tileset (in a variety of fun colors), a castle tileset, probably some other ones too. I'll even make more- it's fun.
I will NEVER be able to write a game, but maybe you will.
Would anyone be interested in a resource like this? I think people like creating their own, but if you want something that's just out of the box ready for your monsters, your spells, etc., I built it and the coding part is done.
It uses a variety of scripts from Victor, Yanfly, Escriole (think I got the name right), Galv, Tsukihime, some others. Anything that's normally considered "incompatible" and doesn't work together I coded so it does.
I don't know if we're allowed to put game engines with scripts from other people in here, but all the scripts are (or were back then at least), free/open source for everyone to use as they will, just need credit. Every script int he engine is credited in the sidebar with the name of the creator.
I can post some pictures if you want them, I'm just gauging interest.
If this is useful to anyone let me know and I'll go ahead and post it.
Note: It DOES work out of the box, but it also DOES need to be refactored. I built this as I was learning CS in college, so some base windows are hardcoded and not default to RPG Maker anymore. This could cause issues with additional scripts put into it, and it's just SUPER sloppy. After I learned how classes actually worked (thanks weird CS professor!), I made it modular and re-write classes properly.
Anyway, if you're interested reply, just let me know. I will provide support and refactor, and even try to make your scripts work with it and troubleshoot issues. That's literally fun for me- making an ACTUAL story isn't.
Oh, one last thing I guess. Here's some stuff about it that's probably relevant:
Everything visually looks like the PSP version of FF4- menu screen, battle screen, ATB gauges, left press for defend/guard, 5 person party (by default), shop window, stats window, bestiary, etc.
It has the FF6 relic system.
All equipment/skills can be heavily tagged to customize it however you want- it's all integrated.
It has events for treasure chests, bridges, random battles on the world map by region ID.
It has premade EXP/Stat curves for various classes.
It has integrated most of Yanfly's scripts and some of Victor's, so classes, subclasses, the FF6 Esper system, the FF9 "learn skills by equipping weapons" system, so many systems all ready to go.
Turns out I have a systems design brain and not a narrative brain, haha. If you're interested let me know. If this is weirdly against rules, let me know that too- it's been awhile since I've been on here. If you want a full script list let me know that too and I'll slap it in here.
Later!

posts.author: ZombieBear
posts.body:
I've been going through the project and it's a LOT of scripts. To keep it short it has a lot of Yanfly's scripts, a lot of Victor's, Tsukihime, and those are the major ones. There are edits of the base classes that I think I made... wasn't the best programmer then... but I looked through it and couldn't find any issues so it might already be cleaned up.
So, the biggest thing that I would want some feedback on is what state would you want it in? I have battle sprites in there I was testing with Victor's Animated ATB script and it all works, but I won't be releasing the sprites. You'd basically be getting a bunch of characters and classes that are statted out, but with no supporting sprites, so they won't show up in battle and it could throw errors...
I can spend some time to clean it up and switch the settings to use some default sprites so it works out of the box... Would this be the easiiet option for people? I don't mind- I just started working on a personal project and I don't mind sharing the love that is my engine, so I'll even be around to answer questions and debug. At this point you guys would be helping me by reporting bugs so I can fix it in the system.
Just let me know in some comments- make it all work out of the box with sprites, battles etc? Or do you all want the support for FF style 32x64 battlers with step animations? Just let me know.
Edit: Whoa, just got another reply! I'm glad there's some interest. Feel free to leave some comments about what you guys would like the state to be in- I won't think it's needy or weird. I can clean it up to whatever spec will be easiiet. Game dev shouldn't be getting stuck behind coding an engine when most people can't program- I had to painstakingly get a CS degree to make this stuff work, hahaha.
